Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
- What is the apportioned ratio fixed towards Savings Fund and member under Grioup
1. Insurance Fund from the subscription of a Insurance Scheme?  
The apportionment ratio was recommended by Seventh CPC to be enhanced to 75:25 towards Savings Fund and Insurance Fund respectively, but currently it is 70:30.  
2. From which date are employees enrolled as members. of Group Insurance Scheme?  
Employees are enrolled as members of the scheme only from 1st January every year.
